data.name: Chughtoon
data.gender_notes: Chughtoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is born during the full moon night or during the 15th night of the Islamic lunar month of Sha'ban. It is also used to describe someone who is beautiful and full of grace. The name Chughtoon carries the meaning “Full Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Chughtoon usually hope their child will grow to embody full moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and protection. Chughtoon signifies the arrival of blessings and a sense of peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Chughtoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Full Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chughtoon total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: چوختون

in_hindi.name: चुग्थून

in_pashto.name: چوختون
in_pashto.long_meaning: چوختون نومګی دوه ځلاکونو لوریوونکی، دوه چاروونکی، او دوه داسونکی دی چی پښتنو کښه د خپل جادگړي او د خپل ټپونو پورته د مزارنو په نوم پېژندل کېږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Chughtoon" has a rich cultural significance in the Islamic community. It is believed that individuals born during the nights mentioned hold special significance and blessings. In many Muslim societies, such babies are lavished with love and gifts as they are believed to bring good luck and prosperity. Moreover, the name is also associated with the beauty and grace embodied in Prophet Muhammad's daughter, Fatima Al-Zahra (AS), and therefore holds an esteemed place in Muslim names and identities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Chughtoon" represents the spiritual potential and blessings associated with the night of birth. It is a reminder of the divine grace and mercy bestowed upon us, as we all begin our journey on the path to manifesting our highest potential and purpose in life. In the Islamic tradition, the night of birth is seen as a moment of great faith and blessing, and the name "Chughtoon" serves as a reminder of this sacred connection. It encourages individuals to strive for personal growth and to remember the divine guidance and blessings that accompany them on their journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chughtoon is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic words "al-Shakura" or "al-Shakur" meaning the thankful or the grateful. The name symbolizes being deeply appreciative and expressing gratitude towards Allah and His blessings in life.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Chughtoon is a Persian name that means 'giver of good news'. It was a common name during the Sassanid Empire (224-651 AD).
